assertions.name: flutter_product_entry_uses_broker
assertions.reason: Product main.dart initializes ShellCoreClient.product() and does not reference ShellCoreClient.local().
assertions.required_action: Keep product startup on the broker-mediated client.

assertions.name: flutter_authority_operations_broker_mediated
assertions.reason: ShellCoreClient.product() requests health, normalization, content projection, protected-field edit rejection, and command-envelope state from the broker and fail-closes through a broker_unavailable snapshot.
assertions.required_action: Keep new authority surfaces broker-mediated and fail-closed.

assertions.name: flutter_product_snapshot_does_not_promote_probe_state
assertions.reason: ShellCoreClient.product() keeps broker projection/command probes out of product permissions, approvals, authority_map, caller state, and caller audit mappings.
assertions.required_action: Keep future product records sourced from broker-owned state exports, not Flutter-created probes.

assertions.name: flutter_models_do_not_default_evidence_to_passed
assertions.reason: Dart evidence summary defaults do not synthesize PASS or fixed check counts when source JSON omits evidence fields.
assertions.required_action: Keep missing evidence visibly missing until an explicit validator/export supplies it.

assertions.name: flutter_product_path_does_not_spawn_python
assertions.reason: Desktop Flutter lib and owner launch scripts contain no Python snapshot generator invocation or Dart process-spawn API.
assertions.required_action: Keep Python limited to tooling, CI, schema validation, and migration parity.

assertions.name: owner_launch_path_starts_broker_without_python_snapshot
assertions.reason: Owner desktop launch scripts start gui_shell_rust_helper broker-server and pass GUI_SHELL_BROKER_ENDPOINT_JSON without running Python snapshot generation.
assertions.required_action: Keep broker launch in launcher/supervisor code and out of Flutter authority logic.

assertions.name: no_ffi_authority_path
assertions.reason: No Dart FFI, flutter_rust_bridge, MethodChannel, or Rust FFI export token was found in the Flutter/Rust authority surface scan.
assertions.required_action: Keep authority-sensitive Flutter-Rust communication on independent-process IPC.

assertions.name: broker_client_uses_authenticated_loopback_ipc
assertions.reason: BrokerClient uses Socket.connect with broker endpoint/session fields and has no direct bridge or process-start token.
assertions.required_action: Keep request authentication and endpoint discovery covered by broker tests.

assertions.name: broker_client_binds_payload_hash_to_payload
assertions.reason: BrokerClient computes payload_hash from canonical JSON payload instead of sending a fixed dummy hash.
assertions.required_action: Keep Rust broker payload hash mismatch tests passing.

assertions.name: broker_secret_not_projected_to_ui
assertions.reason: Broker session secret tokens are confined to BrokerClient and are not projected through UI/snapshot files.
assertions.required_action: Keep secrets out of display and audit payloads.

assertions.name: flutter_broker_fail_closed_test_coverage
assertions.reason: Flutter tests cover broker unavailable, authentication rejection, stale session, malformed response, and broker.fail_closed setup diagnostics.
assertions.required_action: Keep fail-closed UI tests passing on release candidates.

assertions.name: broker_runtime_restart_persistence_and_shutdown_coverage
assertions.reason: Rust broker test fixtures contain local broker process launch/connect/shutdown, unavailable-after-shutdown behavior, replay rejection after restart, audit chain verification after restart, and tampered/malformed persisted-state rejection coverage. This is not installed product runtime proof.
assertions.required_action: Keep Rust broker IPC and persistence tests passing; Windows installed-path evidence remains a separate release gate.

release_gate_note.reason: Windows installed-path no-Python-runtime and broker-mediated LIVE_RUNTIME evidence is still required before completed product release.
release_gate_note.required_action: Run Windows installed-path broker launch/connect/restart/crash/no-Python-runtime smoke and pass strict Windows release validation.
